processingActor.note: Use an active, approved application processing account with only the intended ticket/team access. Do not persist a bearer token or assume a new service account can access tickets.

intake.note: Choose an explicit ISO timestamp; older tickets are excluded from automatic reconciliation.

workloadBudgetProposal.note: Job limits are not a currency cap: core/optional tasks, one core validation regeneration, provider retries and fallback can each add provider requests. Confirm provider pricing and account spending controls separately.

qualityAcceptanceProposal.note: Starter engineering thresholds for review, not an approved production quality standard.

requiredBeforeEnablement: Human approval of real team IDs for both categories.
An approved effective SLA policy including client tier, calendar, holidays and business-day conversion; do not activate source candidates automatically.
Legitimate requester-submitted tickets and reviewed resolution evidence for the historical corpus.
Passing ticket triage/history/review/job/SLA acceptance with the intended user permissions.
Approved processing user, organisation, intake timestamp, workload limits and monetary provider budget.
